rationale: Relative volume is 6.6x but the price has gone nowhere — a 14-cent day range with the last five one-minute bars frozen at 49.27–49.28 on a few hundred shares — so the volume spike is carrying no directional information. Per-bar volatility (~1.7 cents) barely exceeds the round-trip cost of the 1-cent spread, price is pinned at the session high with no catalyst, and the wide stop needed to survive noise would leave a poor reward-to-risk in either direction. There is no mechanical edge long or short here.
